item.title: Alex's full unique battle theme released for Street Fighter 6 by Japanese band JAM Project
item.description: <p>Alex got his time to shine in the ring last night with <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">his official gameplay trailer</a>, and now fans can rock out to the tunes we heard a bit of in it.</p> <p>Capcom just released the full <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> battle theme for the upcoming DLC character with an apt title and unique sound for the game.</p>

item.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage Version 1.08 patch notes released
item.description: <p>This year will hopefully be a big one for Sega and the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/virtua-fighter/">Virtua Fighter</a> team on multiple fronts with their current game still receiving updates.</p> <p>Sega has now released the Version 1.08 patch notes for Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage though it won't be here for a little while yet.</p>

item.title: Evo Awards 2026 nominees revealed, public voting period is now open
item.description: <p>Last year, the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/feb/15/evo-awards-show-results/">Evo Awards</a> were held for the first time to celebrate the fighting game community as a whole and of course provide some big announcements too.</p> <p>The organizers of the largest fighting game events in the world are currently preparing to hold the Evo Awards for the second time, and the community will have a say in who shall be celebrated on the big stage.</p>

item.title: Invincible VS to allow players to try out DLC characters for free, new fighter to be announced next week
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/2026-fighting-games-guide/">2026 is going to be a very busy year for fighting game fans</a>, and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/">Invincible VS</a> is going to be the next to step up to the plate.</p> <p>Skybound Games recently made an interesting announcement in regards to Invincible VS' future DLC characters that should please players.</p>

item.title: The recurring bad match up of the Street Fighter series
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.youtube.com/@shoguntas'>ShogunTas</a> recently released an interesting video talking about the "worst match up in fighting game history." item.title: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD gets surprise update to improve Switch 2 features, could this happen for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate?
item.description: <p>Donkey Kong Country Returns was released back in late 2010 for the Wii. It's been nearly 16 years since then.</p> <p>The sequel, Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze, was released a little over three years for the Wii U after that. Like any sequel, Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze expanded on the features and playability of Donkey Kong Country Returns.</p>

item.title: Five Capcom characters who are too new to have been in the Versus series fighting games but really need to make the cut in the future
item.description: <p>Capcom have been doing very well lately with their core franchises of Monster Hunter, Resident Evil and Street Fighter and thanks to their successes, we're also seeing them bring back many of their beloved franchises that have been sitting on the bench for too long, with Onimusha set to come back this year, Mega Man finally returning in 2027 and even Okami set to get a brand new title, though currently with an unannounced release window.</p> <p>This is perfectly in line with <a href="https://

item.description: <p>The <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/mortal-kombat-legacy-kollection/'>Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection</a> was released last year, but it felt like there were a number of problems that didn't mesh well with the fans. item.title: Nine new DLC characters teased for Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.youtube.com/@BandaiNamcoAmerica'>Bandai Namco Entertainment America</a> released a new trailer for Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero earlier today. It teased a bunch of new content coming to the game in the near future.</p> <p>Though Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero featured a roster of 182 characters at launch, it would seem that there's still somehow room for even more combatants. A number of interesting DLC fighters were confirmed and teased during this latest trailer.</p>
